entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A barbarian pit fighter who bears the Mirari and is corrupted by it before learning to control it.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: A powerful artifact that everyone on Otaria wants; Kamahl attaches it to his sword.

entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: Kamahl's dying friend who entrusted him with the Mirari.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: A merfolk ambassador who manipulates everyone to seize the Mirari and dies pinned by the sword.

entities.name: Burke
entities.description: Laquatus's nearly indestructible jack, killed by Balthor's spell.

entities.name: Balthor
entities.description: Kamahl's dwarf mentor who dies casting a great spell and is later zombified by Braids.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Kamahl's sister, banished for quarreling with him, who tries to steal the Mirari and is gravely wounded.

entities.name: Seton
entities.description: Kamahl's friend deep in the Krosan forest who cures Jeska.

entities.name: Thriss
entities.description: An enlightened nantuko in the heart of Krosan who helps Kamahl control his strength and desires.

entities.name: Eesha
entities.description: The Order commander who leads a contingent toward the mountains; the Order leader is killed in the forest.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: The Cabal leader who heads a battalion and zombifies Balthor.

entities.name: Llawan
entities.description: The merfolk empress whose mages trapped Laquatus's forces in an underwater bubble.

entities.name: Elite Eight
entities.description: Champions of the barbarian tribes whom Kamahl calls to duel.

entities.name: Auror tribe
entities.description: Kamahl's barbarian tribe in the Pardic Mountains.

entities.name: The Order
entities.description: A faction that sends a contingent after the Mirari.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: A faction that sends a battalion after the Mirari.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: The continent where the story takes place.

entities.name: Krosan Forest
entities.description: The forest where Seton and Thriss live and where the Mirari ends up protected.

entities.name: Pardic Mountains
entities.description: The mountains where Kamahl's home and tribe are.

events.summary: Kamahl keeps his promise to the dying Chainer and takes the Mirari, attaching it to his sword and fighting off challengers on his way home.
events.quote: he takes the Mirari orb for safekeeping.

events.summary: Laquatus, trapped by Llawan's mages and failing diplomatically with the Order and the Cabal, goes to the mainland with Burke to retrieve the Mirari.
events.quote: Laquatus and his jack Burke go personally to the mainland to retrieve the Mirari

events.summary: Under the Mirari's influence Kamahl unites the tribes, defeats the Elite Eight with excessive power and plunges the tribes into civil war.
events.quote: he proclaims himself champion; many, however, refuse his rule because he has gone mad with power, plunging the tribes into civil war.

events.summary: An Order contingent led by Eesha and a Cabal battalion led by Braids head to the mountains while Laquatus plays them against each other.
events.quote: Laquatus tries to play them against each other while pretending to be a friend of both.

events.summary: Jeska and Balthor decide to steal the Mirari; Jeska knocks Balthor out and fights Kamahl, who strikes her after a false report that she killed Balthor.
events.quote: Balthor arrives to clear the misunderstanding, and Kamahl realizes his tragic mistake.

events.summary: Cabal troops attack the village; the barbarians unite and win, and Kamahl resolves to bring the surviving Jeska to Seton, with Balthor carrying the Mirari sword.
events.quote: Kamahl resolves to bring her to his friend Seton , deep in the Krosan forest, to cure her.

events.summary: At the forest's edge Balthor holds off the pursuers and unleashes a great spell that kills himself and Burke; Laquatus discovers his troops were wiped out by Llawan's and forges a flimsy alliance with the Cabal and Order.
events.quote: the dwarf unleashes a great spell that kills them both.

events.summary: Seton agrees to cure Jeska and sends Kamahl to Thriss, who helps him control his strength and desires and commune with nature.
events.quote: gives him substantial help in controlling his strength and desires and makes him able to communicate with nature.

events.summary: An unknown assailant attacks the camps in the forest and the Order leader is killed, blamed on the Cabal, which leaves.
events.quote: An unknown assailant begins to attack the camps, and the Order leader is killed, but the blame is given to the Cabal.

events.summary: Eesha, Braids and Llawan's envoys reveal Laquatus's plotting and abandon the quest for the Mirari, leaving him without support.
events.quote: They decide to leave the former ambassador to his own devices and abandon the quest for the Mirari.

events.summary: Kamahl discovers the assailant is Balthor, zombified by Braids, and ends his undeath in tears.
events.quote: he is Balthor, zombified by Braids and instructed to kill Laquatus.

events.summary: Kamahl kills Laquatus with the Mirari sword, its power now bringing growth and peace, and the forest is rejuvenated.
events.quote: The merman dies pinned by the sword.
